tools.name: inspect_inputs
tools.description: Read input order in an explicit workspace (or fixed default); no API calls.

tools.name: prepare_run
tools.description: Freeze inputs and return a workspace-bound run_id; no API calls.

image_model.description: Model family; the prepared canvas selects base (<=1024), -2k (<=2048), or -4k (<=4096) automatically.
image_model.title: Image Model

tools.name: import_run
tools.description: Bind an existing task without generating; use when resuming legacy tasks in task mode.

tools.name: execute_run
tools.description: Start/resume the bound run. This authorizes paid LLM and image API calls.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Read bound task progress and workspace-relative artifacts; no supplier calls.

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: Read design inside the bound task; no API calls.

tools.name: record_review
tools.description: Record artifact-bound checks in the task's original workspace; no API calls.

tools.name: prepare_revision
tools.description:
Freeze a revision in the parent's workspace; return a new run_id, no API calls.

        Deltas replace the parent's delta completely. v2 keeps its original revision budget.
